import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem compact_neighborhood_avoiding_common_level_locus
  {α ι : Type*} [MetricSpace α] [LocallyCompactSpace α]
  (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (c : ℝ)
  (x : α)
  
  (hxL : x ∉ {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c})
  (U : Set α) (hU : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
  ∃ V : Set α, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧
    closure V ⊆ U ∧ Disjoint (closure V) {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c} := by
  classical
  have hLclosed : IsClosed {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c} := by
    rw [show {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c} =
        ⋂ i ∈ s, f i ⁻¹' ({c} : Set ℝ) by
      ext y
      simp]
    exact isClosed_iInter (fun i =>
      isClosed_iInter (fun hi =>
        isClosed_singleton.preimage (hcont i)))
  
  let W : Set α := U ∩ {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c}ᶜ
  
  have hWopen : IsOpen W := by
    dsimp [W]
    exact hU.inter hLclosed.isOpen_compl
  
  have hxW : x ∈ W := by
    exact ⟨hxU, hxL⟩
  
  have hWnhds : W ∈ nhds x := hWopen.mem_nhds hxW
  
  obtain ⟨K, hKnhds, hKW, hKcompact⟩ :=
    local_compact_nhds hWnhds
  
  have hKclosed : IsClosed K := hKcompact.isClosed
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVK, hVopen, hxV⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_iff.mp hKnhds
  
  have hclosureK : closure V ⊆ K := by
    exact closure_minimal hVK hKclosed
  
  have hclosureW : closure V ⊆ W := by
    intro y hy
    exact hKW (hclosureK hy)
  
  have hclosureU : closure V ⊆ U := by
    intro y hy
    exact (hclosureW hy).1
  
  have hclosurecompact : IsCompact (closure V) := by
    exact hKcompact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hclosureK
  
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint (closure V) {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c} := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hyV hyL
    exact (hclosureW hyV).2 hyL
  
  exact ⟨V, hVopen, hxV, hclosurecompact, hclosureU, hdisjoint⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem compact_neighborhood_avoiding_common_level_locus
  {α ι : Type*} [MetricSpace α] [LocallyCompactSpace α]
  (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (c : ℝ)
  (x : α)
  
  (hxL : x ∉ {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c})
  (U : Set α) (hU : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
  ∃ V : Set α, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧
    closure V ⊆ U ∧ Disjoint (closure V) {y : α | ∀ i ∈ s, f i y = c} := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ : ∃ i ∈ s, f i x ≠ c := by
    by_contra h
    apply hxL
    intro i hi
    by_contra hne
    exact h ⟨i, hi, hne⟩
  
  let W : Set α := U ∩ {y : α | f i y ≠ c}
  
  have hW : IsOpen W :=
    hU.inter ((hcont i).isOpen_preimage _
      (isOpen_compl_iff.mpr isClosed_singleton))
  
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxU, hxi⟩
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hxK, hKW⟩ := exists_compact_subset hW hxW
  
  let V : Set α := interior K
  
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := isOpen_interior
  have hxV : x ∈ V := hxK
  
  have hVcompact : IsCompact (closure V) :=
    hK.closure_of_subset interior_subset
  
  have hVU : closure V ⊆ U :=
    (closure_mono interior_subset).trans
      (hK.closure_subset_of_isOpen hW hKW) |>.trans Set.inter_subset_left
  
  refine ⟨V, hVopen, hxV, hVcompact, hVU, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro y hyV hyL
  
  have hyW : y ∈ W :=
    hK.closure_subset_of_isOpen hW hKW
      (closure_mono interior_subset hyV)
  
  exact hyW.2 (hyL i hi)
